title: The Investor’s Bible with Seth Klarman 6/27/23
summary: Klarman’s first book on investing, the 1991 “Margin of Safety,” is a collector’s item, with individual copies selling for about $1500 on eBay. In the decades since, investors have returned to this “bible” of investing; today, founder of the Baupost Group Seth Klarman is publishing a 7th edition of the iconic book. In this very rare interview, Klarman shares his philosophy on investing, his take on bitcoin, the Federal Reserve, and the prospect of recession, as well as tips for what not to do in today’s market.
